meta.description: Drone-based volume and earthwork calculations in Israel: stockpiles, cut and fill from an aerial survey of the site.

title: Volume calculations
lede: Stockpile, cut and fill volumes from a drone survey of the site.
intro: The elevation model from the survey can be used to calculate stockpile, cut and fill volumes, and to compare them between dates.
The calculation method, reference surface and level of detail are set for each survey. No generic accuracy percentages are stated here.
deliverables: The elevation model used for the calculation
A comparison with a previous date, when one exists

side.title: Talk about volumes
side.text: Describe the material and the area that needs measuring.
